episodes.title: #get_famous
episodes.summary: Top influencer Seo A-ri shocks the internet by coming back to life and spilling the secrets behind her meteoric rise — and tragic downfall.

episodes.title: #following, follower
episodes.summary: An influencer management company sees star potential in A-ri. A surprise phone call from the police station reunites A-ri with a secret admirer.

episodes.title: #likes
episodes.summary: Joon-kyung comes to A-ri's rescue when she is humiliated by Gabin Society. A-ri's provocative Instagram post triggers a maelstrom of hate comments.

episodes.title: #lets_connect
episodes.summary: A-ri befriends a mysterious follower who comes to her defense. Gabin Society members grow furious over A-ri's sudden rise to prominence.

episodes.title: #pandoras_box #the_world_they_live_in
episodes.summary: A-ri sets her sights on Korea's largest shopping district as she embarks on a new business venture. Meanwhile, a night out at a club spirals into mayhem.

episodes.title: #sorrynotsorry #life_is_unfair
episodes.summary: Jin Tae-jeon scrambles to cover up Chae-hee's tracks. A-ri's new business starts to get off the ground — until a rival gets in her way.

episodes.title: #what_a_hotmess #turn_the_tables
episodes.summary: A-ri makes a fashionable comeback, much to the dismay of Gabin Society. Joon-kyung makes a bold move — but will A-ri consent?

episodes.title: #hierarchy #the_world_we_live_in
episodes.summary: A-ri ascends to the peak of the social media hierarchy. Yoon Si-hyeon is confronted with an unsettling truth. A stranger shows up at A-ri's showroom.

episodes.title: #truth_wins #spill_the_tea
episodes.summary: Tae-jeon continues to do damage control. A-ri pulls off a big cross-border deal — and ultimately opts to do the right thing.

episodes.title: #get_your_popcorn_ready
episodes.summary: A former confidant and foe combine forces to bring A-ri down. Joon-kyung vows to stand by A-ri's side, but unfortunate events unfold.

episodes.title: #but_she's_dead
episodes.summary: When tragedy befalls those dearest to her, A-ri decides she's had enough. Si-hyeon presents Tae-jeon with news that has been a long time coming.

episodes.title: #nowhere #but_everywhere #like_you_and_me
episodes.summary: The truth surrounding A-ri's disappearance comes to light — as does the identity of her tormentor. Will A-ri get her revenge, once and for all?
